---
title: "masbayes Rust modules"
---

The Rust kernel powering `masbayes` is split into eight focused modules.
Each section below is the module-level documentation extracted directly
from the corresponding `.rs` file by
[`_scripts/extract-rust-docs.R`](https://github.com/bowo1698/masgenomics-docs/blob/main/_scripts/extract-rust-docs.R),
so this page stays in sync with the source.

For per-function signatures and private-item details, build the full
`cargo doc` HTML locally:

```bash
cd masbayes/src/rust && cargo doc --no-deps --document-private-items --open
```
